title: The Rubric
description: A college of enchantment, and the rite it runs when a new apprentice
is taken in: matriculation by paperwork, a wand that has to be the
wand and not merely shaped like one, an oral examination conducted
by a handler nobody outside the college has registered, and a
graduation that takes the college's word back and hands over the
diploma.
The stage the rite turns on is `my_pack:inducted` -- the same stage
the worked KubeJS script in the manual grants and reads, and the
same ids its handlers register: `my_pack:inducted_check` for the
oral, `my_pack:announce` for the announcement. On a build without
the script, the two custom entries load with a warning naming the
missing handler, which is exactly what an optional-dependency pack
wants to see; nothing here needs the script to load.
This group is also reachable as `the_college` -- a group alias, the
third level at which the format keeps a rename from breaking a
reference.
Read it for: `requiresStage`, `stage` tasks and stage rewards that
grant and remove, `custom` task and reward ids, an `advancement`
task with a `criterion`, `match: strict`, `onlyFromCrafting`, an
`item_tag` task, a title written as a translation key with a
fallback, and a group alias.
